entities.summary: Lisa-Maria Kellermayr was an Austrian doctor. She became known to a broad public when she was massively threatened by opponents of vaccination and critics of the coronavirus protection measures during the COVID-19 pandemic. She then closed her doctor's office and committed suicide a month later.
